How to prioritize for your product

Objective picker (6 ODAX options) → simplified audience builder (location, age, gender, a few high-value interest categories, or just Advantage+ Audience) → Advantage+ Placements (skip manual placement complexity) → daily budget → 1–2 creative formats (image, video) → Pixel-based conversion optimization.
